basic_info.description: Imagine waking up and stepping into the warmth of sunlight spilling through the skylights above. This house feels like it's breathing with you. It's calm. It's comfortable. Each room unfolds naturally living room to dining room, into the family room, with French doors open wide to the deck. The sun wraps you in a gentle embrace. For a moment, it feels like time slows, and you realize this could be your sanctuaryyour escape from the busy world outside. Coffee in hand, you step onto the deck and let the morning sun warm your face. The treehouse in the garden catches your eye  an invitation to wander, to create, to laugh. The day ahead is full of possibilities. As the afternoon passes, you feel the pull of the neighborhood. Sanchez Street is just beyond your doorstepone of the last slow streets in the city, a hidden gem. People walk their dogs, greet one another with smiles, and the Noe Caf is just a block away -- where the neighborhood becomes part of the rhythm of your life. As evening falls, you gaze upon the serenity of your prized rear garden before retreating into the comforts of your home. Inside, upstairs, three bedrooms await, each one its own hideaway. Below, there's room to play, to work, to breathe  whatever you need to create, to unwind, to call this place home.
